stepBody:
After applying PCA, you keep the top two PCs for clustering. The scatter plot shows each panda as a point in the two dimensional PC space.
You use hierarchical clustering to group pandas based on their positions in the two dimensional PC space. Each point (labeled $$1$$ - 6) represents a panda. Start with each panda in its own cluster and use the distance between pandas to measure similarity.
Each subpart below is independent.
After $$3$$ steps of agglomerative clustering using single linkage, is this panda in the same cluster as Panda 4? Select all that apply.
